a Nasdaq notification dated November 2, 2026, for non-compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq.
Baird Medical has 180 calendar days, until May 3, 2027, to regain compliance.
To regain compliance, the company's shares must maintain a closing bid price of at least $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days.

If the company fails to meet the requirement by May 3, 2027, it may qualify for an additional 180-day compliance period, subject to meeting other Nasdaq listing requirements and submitting a compliance plan.

title: Baird Medical receives Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice; shares fall
